text.p: HUBCO Inc said on Friday that its Connecticut subsidiary, Lafayette American Bank and Trust Co, has completed its acquisition of UST Bank/Connecticut from UST Corp for about $13 million.
Under the terms of the agreement, UST Corp was paid cash equal to UST Bank/Connecticut's capital, less the deferred tax asset, plus a seven percent deposit premium on UST Bank/Connecticut's deposits.
UST Bank/Connecticut was a $112 million asset commercial bank with $69 million in loans and $100 million in deposits with four offices in Fairfield County, Conn., HUBCO said.
The merger of UST Bank/Connecticut into Lafayette American Bank will increase Lafayette's branch offices to 22 and increases its asset size to approximately $1.0 billion, the company said.
